CO-ACT-CPS | Operator assurance

Recorded simulation evidence. Scenario names are evaluation metadata. Cards and explanations use the saved policy observations; no attack labels or vehicle truth are supplied to the explanation.

Conditional assurance only. Requires honest initial context, the stated honest-source subset, bounded actuator error and modeled timing. Valid signatures do not establish measurement truth. Human effectiveness has not been evaluated.

Command authorization

Speed estimate assurance

A command can pass its stopping check while the reported point estimate lacks this speed-error budget.

Authority and context

Stopping certification does not detect every compromised initial context or excessive actuator disturbance. Those failures remain in the research results.
